title: Google Ads for Local Service Based Businesses

facts.fact: The vendor states that with some industries seeing cost-per-click rates soaring above $50, even one misstep can result in wasted budget and poor lead quality.
facts.quote: With some industries seeing cost-per-click (CPC) rates soaring above $50, even one misstep can result in wasted budget and poor lead quality.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends launching a remarketing campaign only after the website audience exceeds 1,000 visitors.
facts.quote: Don’t launch a display remarketing campaign until your website audience exceeds 1,000 visitors.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends allocating 5–10% of the total Search budget to a remarketing campaign.
facts.quote: Allocate 5–10% of your total Search budget

facts.fact: The vendor recommends letting a remarketing campaign run for 60–90 days to measure performance.
facts.quote: Let the campaign run for 60–90 days to measure performance

facts.fact: In the vendor's IT support example, cost per lead dropped from $107 to $59 after adding negative keywords and rewriting ads to target small businesses only.
facts.quote: their cost per lead dropped from $107 to $59.

facts.fact: In the vendor's IT support example, cost per lead was over $100 before changes, largely due to calls from residential customers instead of small businesses.
facts.quote: An IT support company saw costs per lead of over $100, largely due to calls from residential customers instead of small businesses.

facts.fact: The vendor advises setting location targeting to 'Presence' only so ads show only to people physically in the service area, not those merely interested in it.
facts.quote: Set your targeting to “Presence” only. This ensures your ads show only to people physically located in your service area

facts.fact: The vendor advises reviewing the search terms report weekly to refine targeting and reduce irrelevant clicks.
facts.quote: Review your search terms report weekly to refine targeting and reduce irrelevant clicks

facts.fact: The vendor advises using 'Target' rather than 'Observation' for remarketing audience targeting.
The vendor recommends starting with Search campaigns rather than Performance Max to build conversion data before scaling.
facts.quote: When launching or optimizing Google Ads, always begin with Search campaigns, not Performance Max (PMAX)
